description: Demolition of existing garages and erection of a three storey building with two one-bedroom and four two-bedroom dwellings with two car parking spaces and associated cycle and waste storage, landscaping and boundary treatment.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (3667J - LB - XX - ZZ - DR - A - 101000 RevP2, 3667J - LB - XX - 03 - DR - A - 120003 RevP2, 3667J - LB - XX - ZZ - DR - A - 110000 Rev P2, Construction Logistic Plan, Design and Access Statement, Fire Safety Statement, Preliminary Groundwater Screening Assessment, Sustainability Report, Noise impact assessment, Planning & Heritage Statement, Transport Note and Arboricultural Impact Assessment Report- received 28/09/2021
3667J-LB-XX-XX-DD-L-230000 RevP1, 3667J-LB-XX-00-DR-L-200000 RevP3, unnumbered proposed elevation- received 16/03/2022
Daylight and sunlight report- 6/04/2022 3667J - LB - QC - 00 - DR - A - 120000 RevP3, 3667J - LB - QC - 01 - DR - A - 120001 RevP3 and 3667J - LB - QC - 02 - DR - A - 120002 RevP3- received 26/04/2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the details shown on the approved plans, prior to first occupation of the hereby approved development, elevations of the proposed secure cycle storage arrangements shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The cycle parking shall comprise 'Sheffield' stands and shall conform to the West London Cycle Parking Guidance. The cycle store and the guest cycle parking shall be made available to occupants on first occupation of the approved development and maintained as such thereafter without obstruction.

Condition : 6 - A.	The hereby approved development must be carried out in accordance with the approved Energy Statement received 28/09/2021.
B.	Prior to first occupation of any dwelling within the development hereby approved evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the Standard Assessment Procedure/National Calculation Method) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy, and any subsequent approved revisions.
C.	Upon final commencement of operation of any low and zero carbon technologies, performance data for energy consumption must be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The performance data shall be submitted every 18 months to a monitoring web-platform for a period of three years from the point of full operation.
D.	If the development as implemented fails to result in a net zero-carbon development, as indicated by the first set of data recovered under clause 'C' above, the applicant shall, within six months of first occupation have entered into a binding arrangement with the Council that will secure a suitable contribution to the Council's Carbon Offset Fund to compensate fully for this shortfall at the rate applicable at the time of first occupation

Condition : 7 - Prior to first occupation of the building(s) evidence (schedule of fittings and manufacturers' literature) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has achieved an internal water use of 105 Litres per person per day or less.

Condition : 8 - The development shall not be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of delivery notes, invoices or installation contracts) have been submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development meets the following:
o	At least three of the key elements of the building envelope (external walls, windows roof, upper floor slabs, internal walls, floor finishes/coverings) are to achieve a rating of A+ to D in the Building Research Establishment (BRE) The Green Guide of specification.
o	At least 50% of timber and timber products are to be sourced from accredited Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) or Programme for the Endorsement of Forestry Certification (PEFC) scheme.
o	No construction or insulation materials are to be used which will release toxins into the internal and external environment, including those that deplete stratospheric ozone.

Condition : 9 - Notwithstanding the details on the approved plans, prior to commencement of groundworks (excluding site investigations and demolition), the applicant shall have submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval in writing a final detailed drainage design, including drawings and supporting calculations and an updated Drainage Assessment Form to be reviewed and approved by the Lead Local Flood Authority. The drainage hierarchy shall make use of green infrastructure technology to comply with the hierarchy set out in London Plan Policy SI3 and the runoff rate must not exceed 2.5litres/second.  A detailed management plan confirming routine maintenance tasks for all drainage components shall also be submitted and approved which demonstrates how the drainage system is to be maintained for the lifetime of the development. The development shall be carried out in strict compliance with the approved details.

Condition : 10 - No part of the development hereby approved shall be occupied until evidence (photographs and copies of installation contracts, along with a written confirmation) has been submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to demonstrate that the sustainable drainage scheme approved under the preceding condition has been completed in accordance with the submitted final detailed drainage designs. The sustainable drainage scheme shall be managed and maintained thereafter in accordance with the agreed management and maintenance plan for all of the proposed drainage components.

Condition : 11 - "Before the development hereby permitted commences:
a.	A contaminated land Phase 1 desk study report shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.  Should the Phase 1 report recommend that a Phase 2 site investigation is required, then this shall be carried out and submitted to, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The site shall be investigated by a competent person to identify the extent and nature of contamination. The report should include a tiered risk assessment of the contamination based on the proposed end use of the site.  Additional investigation may be required where it is deemed necessary.
b.	If required, a scheme for decontamination of the site shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority, for written approval.  The scheme shall account for any comments made by the Local Planning Authority before the development hereby permitted is first occupied.
   During the course of the development:
c.	The Local Planning Authority shall be notified immediately if additional contamination is discovered during the course of the development. A competent person shall assess the additional contamination, and shall submit appropriate amendments to the scheme for decontamination in writing to the Local Planning Authority for approval before any work on that aspect of development continues.  
   Before the development is first brought into use:
d.	The agreed scheme for decontamination referred to in clauses b) and c) above, including amendments, shall be fully implemented and a written validation (closure) report submitted to the Local Planning Authority for approval.
Condition : 12 - The development hereby permitted shall obtain a 'Secured by Design' certificate before it is first occupied and shall continue to meet the certified standard.

Condition : 13 - Before first occupation of the hereby approved development the waste and recycling stores shall be made available for use in accordance with the approved plans and shall thereafter be retained as such, without obstruction, for the duration of the development.

Condition : 14 - In this condition 'retained tree' means any existing tree which is to be retained in accordance with the approved plans and particulars, and paragraphs (a) and (b) below shall have effect until the expiration of five years from the date of the occupation of any of the buildings hereby approved.
(a) No retained tree shall be cut down, uprooted or destroyed, nor shall any retained tree be topped or lopped other than in accordance with the approved plans and particulars, without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority. Any topping or lopping approved shall be carried out in accordance with British Standard 3998 (Tree Work) or any other BS replacing this.
(b) If any retained tree is removed, uprooted or destroyed or dies, another tree shall be planted at the same place and that tree shall be of such size and species, and shall be planted at such time, as may be specified in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 15 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, the Local Planning Authority shall be informed of the agreed naming and numbering of the proposed dwellings so that arrangements can be put in place to ensure that, with the exception of a person eligible for a disabled person's badge issued pursuant to section 21 of the Chronically Sick and Disabled Persons Act 1970 (or similar legislation), no resident of the development shall obtain a resident's parking permit. Any occupiers of the approved development shall surrender any such permit wrongly issued or held.

Condition : 16 - Prior to the commencement of above ground works the developer shall have entered into a binding agreement to secure the provision on the adjacent highway of the two parking spaces shown on the approved drawings and the spaces provided before the development is first occupied. This provision shall be made permanently available for disabled drivers and shall be used for no other purpose.

Condition : 17 - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use, the existing vehicular accesses to Station Approach Road shall be permanently closed and kerbs and footway reinstated and raised; and a conventional vehicular access shall be provided. The access shall be constructed in accordance with the Local Authority Highways specifications before the development hereby permitted is first occupied or brought into use.

Condition : 18 - Prior to the commencement of above ground works the developer shall have entered into a binding agreement to secure the provision on the adjacent highway of two Active Electric Vehicle Charging Points each capable of a minimum output of 7.2kW and the details so agreed shall be provided.  Full details shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The details shall include the number, location and manufacturer's specifications.
The charging points shall be installed and available for use before the development is first occupied in accordance with the approved details and so maintained at all times thereafter.
